positions.meaning: ボードの上の Issue の置き場所。設定ファイルは書かない
1 つの Issue の作業の始まりから終わりまで
PR の自動レビューの実行
Issue のラベルを契機にした自動処理の実行
Tracker の Issue の書き直し
公式の GitHub の MCP に手の無い、GitHub の 1 つの操作
GitHub の状態に合わせて書き直す
終わった後の片付けをする
動かすかどうかを決める
入力で選んだ操作を 1 つ行い、結果を返す

entries.name: auto finish
entries.description: Finish an automated fix run. Decide the result, post the result comment, set the waiting Status and remove the trigger label, unless this run already posted one.

body-file.description: Path of a file with the text for result (only with result)

execution-file.description: Path of the execution_file output of claude-code-action (may be empty)

issue.description: Issue number in the repository of the workflow, or owner/repo/N

job-status.description: Status of the job (job.status). Required without result

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the repository of the Issue; when several do, the active one among them

result.description: Result to write as it is, for a step that decided it (pr-created, ci-passed, ci-fix-pushed, question, out-of-scope, failed, limit or setup-missing). Not used with job-status, execution-file, start-outcome or result-file

result-file.description: Path of the result file the skill writes, with the result in the frontmatter and the text in the body. A missing file means the skill wrote no result

start-outcome.description: Outcome of the auto-start step (steps.<id>.outcome). Required without result

token.description: Token to write the comment, the board and the label (the App token of the workflow)

entries.name: auto gate
entries.description: Decide from the issues or workflow_run event whether the automated fix runs, and of what kind. Post the result comment and remove the trigger label when the Issue is out of scope or the CI fixes reached the limit.

max-ci-attempts.description: Maximum number of CI fixes on one branch

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the repository of the event; when several do, the active one among them

token.description: Token to read the Issue and the board and to write the result comment (the App token of the workflow)

outputs.branch: Existing branch of the Issue; empty when none
outputs.issue: Issue (owner/repo/N); empty when the branch of the workflow run does not end with an Issue number
outputs.kind: Kind of the run (start, resume, ci-fix or ci-passed); empty when it is not decided
outputs.proceed: Whether the agent runs (true or false)

entries.name: auto start
entries.description: Start an automated fix run. Put the Issue on the board or restore the Status the automation wrote, and write the context to continue to a JSON file.

issue.description: Issue number in the repository of the workflow, or owner/repo/N

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the repository of the Issue; when several do, the active one among them

token.description: Token to read the Issue and to write the board (the App token of the workflow)

outputs.context-file: Path of the JSON file with the Issue, the plan, the earlier results, the answers, the branch and the PR, under RUNNER_TEMP

entries.name: board sync
entries.description: Move the Issues in Ready, Blocked, Active and In Review to the columns and Status values their judgment calls for, and delete the Archived items beyond the latest 20 from the board.

dry-run.description: Show the planned moves without writing to the board

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the active project; when none is active and only one config exists, that one

token.description: Token to read and write the project board (the App token or PAT of the workflow)

entries.name: github ops
entries.description: Run one GitHub operation that the official GitHub MCP server has no tool for, and print the result as one PECOT_RESULT line of JSON in the job log.

operation.description: Operation to run: link-branch, stack-register, project-fields, project-view, project-link, repo-settings, workflow-doctor or release-create

params.description: JSON object with the values of the operation. link-branch: issue, branch, base (default: the default branch). stack-register: pr, parent_pr. project-fields: project, changes (each one of create {name, options}, rename {name, to}, delete {name}, set-options {name, options}). project-view: project, name, column, row. project-link: project, repo (default: this repository). repo-settings and workflow-doctor: none. release-create: tag, sha, body, name (default: tag), prerelease (default: false)

request-id.description: ID the caller chose for this run. It is copied into the result line, so the caller can tell its run apart

token.description: Token for the operation. GITHUB_TOKEN for link-branch, stack-register and repo-settings; the App token for project-fields, project-view, project-link, workflow-doctor and release-create

entries.name: release check
entries.description: Check that a release can go out. Check the open code scanning and secret scanning alerts (open Dependabot alerts only warn). For a repository that is not released with Nx, also check the CHANGELOG, the tag and the commits to release.

log-file.description: File to write the output lines to as well (overwritten). The directory is created

package.description: Package name in a monorepo. Required for a repository with packages configured; must be empty for a repository released with Nx

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

token.description: Token to read the alerts and the commits (the App token of the workflow)

version.description: Release version. Detected from the CHANGELOG when empty. Must be empty for a repository released with Nx

entries.name: review finish
entries.description: Finish an automated review. Post one comment on the PR only when the review stopped (failed, limit or setup-missing).

execution-file.description: Path of the execution_file output of claude-code-action

pr.description: PR number in the repository of the workflow, or owner/repo/N

review-conclusion.description: The conclusion output of claude-code-action. Pass it even when empty; empty means Claude Code did not run

review-has-token.description: Whether claude-code-action output a github_token (true or false; never the token itself)

review-outcome.description: Outcome of the automated review step (steps.<id>.outcome)

since.description: Start time of the review step in ISO 8601, to find the inline comments it posted. Empty means the stop location is unknown

token.description: Token to read the PR and write the comment (the App token of the workflow)

entries.name: session finish
entries.description: Clean up on GitHub after a merged PR. Close the Issues the PR closes (except Epics) and move the Issues waiting for them on the board. It does not delete branches.

pr.description: PR number in the repository of the workflow, or owner/repo/N

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

token.description: Token to close the Issues and write the project board (the App token or PAT of the workflow)

entries.name: tracker sync
entries.description: Rewrite the open Tracker's list for a source in the repository of the workflow. Dependabot PRs waiting for a human decision, or open security alerts.

dry-run.description: Show the planned Tracker changes without changing anything

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that has the repository of the workflow

source.description: What to put into the Tracker: dependabot (Dependabot PRs waiting for a human decision) or security (open security alerts)

token.description: Token to read the PRs or alerts and write the Tracker and the board (the App token or PAT of the workflow)
